text:
Ivy: Quick check after launch — lets pick 3 tiny follow-ons we can commit to for the next 2 sprints. Keep infra work minimal.

Noah: My vote: 1) API 429 backoff + idempotency header, 2) streaming UX shows last-received token timestamp, 3) small docs update about rate limits.

Priya: +1. Add a grooming ticket to attach rollback plans to each PR. Last time we were scrambling to revert.

Marcus: Ests: 1) 1 day (edge retry + tests), 2) 4h (UX + copy), 3) 1h. Embed-related rollbacks are bigger so leave out of this mini-batch.

Ivy: Acceptance criteria idea: for 429 fix -> "<1% 429s per org in 24h; no p99 increase >25%". For streaming -> "shows last-chunk timestamp; no visual regressions in QA".

Noah: Ops guardrail: add synthetic probe hitting retry path every 30s during canary, abort if p95 >20% or error rate >2x baseline.

Priya: I'll run the grooming Loom and add a checkbox "rollback plan" to the PR template.

ReleaseBot: [notice] Canary job queued for API retry patch. Window = 2h, auto-rollback thresholds configured.

Marcus: I'll own the retry patch and the canary orchestration. Noah can pair on QA.

Ivy: Perfect. I'll create the sprint slices and tag owners. If anyone objects to scope, flag in 4h. :thumbsup:
